name: node-test
description: Run the reviewed llm-tracker Session Hub Tracks 1-4 node --test verification suite from the repository root.
risk_reasons: Tests may bind loopback ports and write temporary files.

constraints: The template must be invoked from the llm-project-tracker repository root with templates_dir set to . or by repo-relative path node-test.json.
The executed command shape is always /usr/local/bin/node --test followed by the reviewed fixed test files.
The suite input is an exact enum and cannot inject additional test paths or Node flags.
invariants: No shell, pipe, redirection, command substitution, or caller-supplied argv is used.
The test file list is fixed in the reviewed template definition.
